title: Tensor pullback sections are locally spanned by sections on base opens
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M an arbitrary Zariski O_T-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and V an object u:V to T of the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Put P_M(U)=Gamma(U,u_U^*M), using the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and the unit-normalized semilinear restrictions rho [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. For an open W of T, let e_W:P_M(i_W) to M(W) be tensorOpenSectionIso [new-etale-tensor-open-section-iso]. For every s in P_M(V), there exists a covering sieve S on V such that, for every g:U to V in S, rho_g(s) lies in the Gamma(U,O_U)-linear span of all rho_f(e_W^{-1}(m)), where W ranges over opens of T, m ranges over M(W), and f ranges over all arrows U to i_W in T_et. The sieve may depend on s. This asserts a local generation property of the source alone, with no target sheaf or maps from it. Empty schemes, empty opens and arbitrary zero modules are included; no quasi-coherence is assumed.

proof.text: Fix an etale object u:V to T and a section s of u^*M. By the explicit tensor construction, u^*M is the sheafification of O_V tensor over u^{-1}O_T with u^{-1}M. Local surjectivity of sheafification represents s around each point by a section of this tensor presheaf, which is a finite sum of pure tensors. Each of the finitely many sections of u^{-1}M is locally represented by a section m_j of M on an open W_j of T, because inverse image is the sheafification of the presheaf colimit over base opens. Refine the finitely many neighborhoods simultaneously. We get an open A of V mapping into every W_j and an equality of s restricted to A with the sum of functions on A times the actual unit pullbacks of m_j.

For i:W into T, the unit-compatible open comparison identifies (tensorOpenSectionIso T M W).inv(m) with the i-unit of m, under the canonical identification of sections on W with sections on its open subscheme. For A to W over T, the normalization of tensorSectionsComp makes restriction of this section precisely the unit pullback of m along A to T. The same open comparison for A into V identifies ordinary restriction of s with etaleTensorSectionsRestriction along A into V. Its map on sections is linear over functions on A, so the equality in the first step gives membership of the normalized restriction of s in the displayed span.

The open A chosen around each point cover V; inclusions of opens are etale and hence give a covering family in the small etale site. Generate the sieve S by these inclusions. For any further arrow, restriction takes a generator indexed by f:U to i_W to the generator indexed by its composite, by functoriality of etaleTensorSectionsRestriction. Semilinearity restricts the coefficients in any finite linear combination. Thus the span property is inherited by all arrows in the generated sieve, giving the conclusion. An empty V has the empty covering sieve; zero sections belong to every span. No quasi-coherence or finiteness assumption on M is used.
